So this pin makes the dogfood suite red on every registrar move for a number nothing is derived from. Dogfood is skipped on PR CI, so the split PR does not see it and `main` goes red after the merge.

The case keeps everything else it already asserts: `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_PATHS[0]` is `rest-server.ts`; both probes read exactly the listed files in order (`alsoReads` and `probeSource`); zero hits over the list; no rest-server tripwire key is minted. Add `expect(REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)` only if the case would pass on an empty list. The probe-text equality may already red there, so measure it. The `Length N → M` lines stay as history with one closing `[#<this card>]` line.

**Also:** `packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts:23-26` still says each reader "pins the list's `length`". After #26518, only this copy and the `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts:848` alias (on #26436) still pin it. Whichever of this card and #26436 lands last rewords that sentence.

**Acceptance:** `git grep -n "REGISTRAR_FILES).toHaveLength" -- packages/qa` → 0. The PR shows the case still reds on a probe that skips a listed file (one ablation) and stays green when a name is appended to the list (one dry move). The dogfood authz-conformance file passes. **Size:** XS. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
